mapper.sql: id, question, status, stop_reason, final_answer, total_tokens, tool_calls, elapsed_ms, node, error, created_at, updated_at, failure_cause, intent, conversation_id, tenant_id, workspace_dir, permission_level
run_id, step_index, transcript, thought_text, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, elapsed_ms, cache_read_tokens, model_name, prompt_fingerprint, canary_variant
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run (id, question, status, node, intent, conversation_id, tenant_id, workspace_dir, permission_level) VALUES (#{id}, #{question}, 'RUNNING', #{node}, #{intent}, #{conversationId}, #{tenantId}, #{workspaceDir}, #{permissionLevel})

INSERT INTO agent_step (run_id, step_index, thought_text, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cache_read_tokens, model_name, prompt_fingerprint, canary_variant, elapsed_ms, transcript) VALUES (#{runId}, #{stepIndex}, #{thoughtText}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{cacheReadTokens}, #{modelName}, #{promptFingerprint}, #{canaryVariant}, #{elapsedMs}, #{transcript}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE thought_text = VALUES(thought_text), prompt_tokens = VALUES(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = VALUES(completion_tokens), cache_read_tokens = VALUES(cache_read_tokens), model_name = VALUES(model_name), prompt_fingerprint = VALUES(prompt_fingerprint), canary_variant = VALUES(canary_variant), elapsed_ms = VALUES(elapsed_ms), transcript = VALUES(transcript)

INSERT INTO agent_tool_invocation (run_id, step_index, call_index, call_id, tool_name, arguments, stage, feedback, elapsed_ms) VALUES (#{runId}, #{stepIndex}, #{callIndex}, #{callId}, #{toolName}, #{arguments}, #{stage}, #{feedback}, #{elapsedMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE call_id = VALUES(call_id), tool_name = VALUES(tool_name), arguments = VALUES(arguments), stage = VALUES(stage), feedback = VALUES(feedback), elapsed_ms = VALUES(elapsed_ms)

INSERT INTO retrieval_call (run_id, step_index, call_index, tool_name, query, top_k, hit_count, index_size, elapsed_ms) VALUES (#{runId}, #{stepIndex}, #{callIndex}, #{toolName}, #{query}, #{topK}, #{hitCount}, #{indexSize}, #{elapsedMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tool_name = VALUES(tool_name), query = VALUES(query), top_k = VALUES(top_k), hit_count = VALUES(hit_count), index_size = VALUES(index_size), elapsed_ms = VALUES(elapsed_ms)

INSERT INTO retrieval_hit (run_id, step_index, call_index, hit_rank, chunk_id, document_id, breadcrumb, token_count, score, excerpt) VALUES (#{runId}, #{stepIndex}, #{callIndex}, #{rank}, #{chunkId}, #{documentId}, #{breadcrumb}, #{tokenCount}, #{score}, #{excerpt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE chunk_id = VALUES(chunk_id), document_id = VALUES(document_id), breadcrumb = VALUES(breadcrumb), token_count = VALUES(token_count), score = VALUES(score), excerpt = VALUES(excerpt)
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = #{expected}
UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{runId}
UPDATE agent_step SET transcript = #{transcript} WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND step_index = #{stepIndex}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_run WHERE status = #{status} AND node = #{node} ORDER BY updated_at
SELECT FROM agent_run ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM agent_run WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at, id
SELECT FROM agent_step WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY step_index DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM agent_step WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY step_index
SELECT run_id, step_index, call_index, call_id, tool_name, arguments, stage, feedback, elapsed_ms FROM agent_tool_invocation WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY step_index, call_index

SELECT h.step_index, h.call_index, h.hit_rank, h.chunk_id, h.document_id, h.breadcrumb, h.token_count, h.score, h.excerpt, c.tool_name FROM retrieval_hit h JOIN retrieval_call c ON c.run_id = h.run_id AND c.step_index = h.step_index AND c.call_index = h.call_index WHERE h.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY h.step_index, h.call_index, h.hit_rank
SELECT step_index, call_index, tool_name, query, top_k, index_size, elapsed_ms FROM retrieval_call WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY step_index, call_index
